name: frihet-mcp
description: Manage a connected Frihet workspace: invoices, quotes, expenses, clients, products and other available business operations. Use for Frihet requests, facturas, presupuestos, gastos, cobros, overdue invoices, monthly review or revisión mensual. Reads current tool schemas before acting, separates currencies and prepares changes for approval. Requires a connected Frihet MCP server.
